d:
Shaggy, shoulder-length, ink black hair with wild, unkempt texture and long bangs. Deep amber, narrow eyes with a sinister, calculating expression. Apparent age of late 40s with a rugged, weathered maturity. Tall, lean build. Wears a traditional Russian dark brown peasant tunic and a heavy charcoal grey overcoat. Features a long, unkempt salt-and-pepper beard and a large, ornate Orthodox cross necklace.
BODY COLOR: pale beige
